SellerProduct.name: SellerProduct
SellerProduct.description: Represents information about the products associated with a seller. Provides insight into product availability, production details, and the seller's role for the product, such as for sales or for service.

AccountId.description: The account associated with the product.

EndDate.description: The date when the seller stopped selling or servicing this product.

IsActive.description: Indicates whether the product is still associated with the seller (true) or not (false).

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, it’s possible that this record was referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

ProductId.description: The product associated with the account.

SellerRole.description: The role of the seller related to the product, such as for sales or for service.

StartDate.description: The date when the seller started selling or servicing this product.
